U.note: Clean iOS-like dark calculator with correct chaining and error handling, but few aria labels and a generic look.

V.note: Polished dark UI with good aria and keyboard, but extra CE/backspace/%, glow backdrop and tiny hint text pad it past basic.

W.note: Warm light theme with clear hierarchy, helpful 'Cannot divide by zero' note, good aria and a lean source.

X.note: Beautiful skeuomorphic LCD calculator with strong craft but overbuilt, large source and a segment display that is harder to read.

Y.note: Smallest and most basic dark calculator, correct, though the divide-by-zero message replaces the display in plain text and aria is minimal.

Z.note: Warm, high-contrast design with dark display, tinted operators and clear Error feedback, good aria and keyboard support.
